For referring providers

What to send with your order

The essentials Medicare requires — nothing more. Fax the order with the items below and we'll take it from there.

Every order needs

  • Patient name and date of birth
  • Copy of the insurance card — front and back
  • Signed order with the ordering provider's name, NPI, signature and date
  • Diagnosis
  • Recent chart notes supporting medical necessity
  • Patient phone number and delivery address

Sleep Therapy — CPAP

  • Signed CPAP order (pressure settings if known)
  • Sleep study report — home or in-lab
  • Face-to-face visit note documenting sleep apnea

Home Oxygen

  • Signed order with flow rate (liters per minute)
  • When it's used — at rest, during sleep, on exertion, or continuous
  • Qualifying oxygen test result on room air (blood oxygen level)
  • Chart notes for the qualifying condition

Home Ventilator Service

  • Signed ventilator order
  • Clinical notes documenting the qualifying condition (e.g. ALS, chronic respiratory failure)
  • Face-to-face visit note
  • Current ventilator settings, if available

Breast Pumps

  • Signed prescription / order
  • Diagnosis — pregnancy or lactating mother
  • Expected delivery date

Mobility — Walkers & Rollators

  • Signed order for the item
  • Chart notes documenting the mobility limitation at home
  • Diagnosis

Diabetes & CGM

  • Signed CGM order
  • Diabetes diagnosis
  • Notes documenting insulin use or history of low blood sugar episodes

Questions

Before you ask

Do I need a prescription?
Yes — most equipment we provide (CPAP, oxygen, ventilators, breast pumps through insurance) requires a doctor's order. If you don't have one yet, request an appointment above and we'll coordinate with your physician's office.
Will my insurance cover this?
Often, yes. Medicare and most major Illinois plans cover medically necessary DME, and breast pumps are covered under most plans. We verify your specific coverage and any authorization before delivery, and tell you upfront if you'd owe anything.
Do I need prior authorization?
Some insurance plans require approval before certain equipment is delivered. Jama checks your coverage first and handles the authorization paperwork with your doctor's office, so your delivery is not delayed by surprises.
What is a deductible?
The amount you pay each year before your insurance starts paying its share. If you have not met yours yet, part of your equipment cost may apply to it — we check before delivery and tell you up front.
What is a co-pay?
A fixed amount your plan sets for an item or service — for example, a set amount per month for a rental. Your plan decides the amount; we confirm it for you before you commit.
What is co-insurance?
Your percentage share of the cost after your deductible. For example, Medicare Part B typically pays 80% of the approved amount for most equipment, and the remaining 20% is the patient's share — a Medicare supplement plan or Medicaid often covers that 20%.
How much will I pay out of pocket?
It depends on your plan's deductible, co-pay, and co-insurance. Before we deliver anything, we verify your coverage and tell you your estimated share — no surprises after the fact.
How fast can I get my equipment?
Once your order and insurance verification are complete, we schedule delivery and setup at your home. Urgent respiratory needs are prioritized — call us anytime at 224-580-2168 if your need is time-sensitive.
I'm already a patient — how do I get refills or supplies?
Call 224-580-2168 anytime or use the form above and choose “Resupply / Existing patient.” We'll confirm what's due and schedule your refill so you never run short.
Which areas do you serve?
We serve all of Chicago and the surrounding suburbs — all of Chicagoland. Our office is based in Des Plaines, but we deliver and set up equipment at homes across the whole area, from the city to suburbs near and far. If you're anywhere in Chicago or the suburbs, we can help — just call us at 224-580-2168.
I'm a provider — how do I refer a patient?
Fax orders to 224-443-4392, find us on Parachute Health, or call 224-580-2168 anytime. We handle eligibility, patient outreach, delivery and documentation back to your office. See our referral guide for exactly what to send with each order.
